title: Sweet Jelly Stew
description: A unique and flavorful stew made with jelly and mediterranean ingredients. Perfect for a cold day.
instructions: Heat the water in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the mediterranean spice blend and stir to combine.
Add the sweet potatoes, glassy onion, and yummy carrots to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the jelly to the pot and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
